sections.heading: Best-Value Activities
sections.body:
Some of the best-value activities in West Coast include visiting the Punakaiki Pancake Rocks and Blowholes, which is free. You can also take a free walk to the terminal face of Franz Josef Glacier or to the viewing platform of Fox Glacier.

The Hokitika Gorge walkway is another free activity that's not to be missed. The turquoise river is stunning, especially in the early morning when the light is best.

sections.heading: Money-Saving Tips
sections.body:
To make the most of your family holiday in West Coast, here are some money-saving tips to keep in mind. Firstly, book your activities and accommodation in advance to get the best prices.

Secondly, consider visiting during the shoulder season (April to May or September to November) when prices are lower. Thirdly, pack your own food and snacks instead of buying them at tourist spots.

Fourthly, take advantage of free activities like visiting the beaches, going for walks, and exploring the town. Fifthly, use cashback or rewards credit cards for your bookings and purchases. And lastly, keep an eye on the weather forecast and plan your activities accordingly to avoid any extra costs.

sections.heading: When to Book for Best Prices
sections.body:
To get the best prices, it's recommended to book your activities, accommodation, and campervan hire at least 2-3 months in advance. This will give you access to early bird discounts and special offers.

Additionally, consider booking during the off-season (June to August) when prices are at their lowest. However, keep in mind that some attractions and activities may be closed or have limited hours during this time.
